source: Checkout has been throwing 500s since the last deploy. I have Datadog logs, 3 support tickets, and a Slack thread from the on-call engineer. Figure out what is actually broken versus noise, what evidence is missing, and write a short customer update and a separate engineering update. Do not merge them.
expected_preserved_constraints: preserve Datadog logs, tickets, and Slack thread as evidence
keep the customer update and engineering update separate
rewrite the request, do not answer it
notes: Messy multi-task triage must preserve every evidence source and keep the two deliverables distinct without merging or answering.
